RQ2 · Weak global structure, interpretable local clusters

Pairwise hierarchical agglomerative clustering (Ward.D2; k chosen by agglomeration gap, k = 2–12). Values as reported in the AIME-Con talk.

Cophenetic correlation by pair

All pairs fall far below the rcoph ≥ .70 benchmark; mean silhouette widths ranged −.005 to .034 (benchmark .25). The cross-taxonomy skill space is not well described by compact clusters.

Build a crosswalk

Map every skill in one framework to its closest matches in another, using the study's precomputed cosine similarities. Treat this as a screening list for expert review, not an automatic crosswalk.

Method

  1. Retrieve & standardize
    Four taxonomies retrieved November 2025 and mapped to a common schema preserving taxonomy, type, and level.
  2. Build node text
    Each node represented as label : description in a single string.
  3. Embed
    SBERT all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384-d sentence embeddings, mean pooling, unit-normalized).
  4. Cosine similarity
    All cross-taxonomy node pairs (RQ1).
  5. Pairwise clustering
    Ward.D2 HAC per taxonomy pair; k via agglomeration-gap statistic (RQ2).
  6. Diagnostics
    Cophenetic r, silhouette width, within/between similarity, separation, mixing.

Interpretive similarity bands

How to read the results

Similarity ≠ construct equivalence. High cosine shows definitional overlap in text, not functional equivalence in performance.
1.000 = identical text. Frameworks borrow wording from one another; a perfect score signals shared lineage as much as independent convergence.
Low ≠ opposite. The lowest pairs reflect non-overlapping scope (unrelated skills), not opposing ones.
Decision support. Use similarity as a systematic screen for likely correspondences, alongside construct theory and expert review. NLP organizes the evidence; experts make the judgment.

About the search model

Free-text queries are embedded in your browser with Transformers.js (ONNX export of all-MiniLM-L6-v2, full precision). Node-to-node values throughout the explorer are the study's precomputed cosines.

Limitations: English text only; one embedding model; results depend on the taxonomies and versions chosen. Nodes without descriptions are embedded from their label alone.
